verdict.rationale: Atlas generates founder legal documents from Cooley-built templates and lets founders set inputs such as vesting period, cliff and start date, or create SAFEs from the Dashboard. That covers the template-filling core of the story. There is no evidence that Atlas flags choices needing attorney review, and one founder reports getting no warnings about a high share count that led to large Delaware franchise tax bills. missing for 10: documented guided questionnaire flow, flagging of choices needing attorney review, independent corroboration that the generated documents are filled correctly.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer guided questionnaires that fill in legal documents correctly and flag choices that need attorney review

citations.quote: Atlas helps you set up a company using templates created in collaboration with Cooley LLP.
Customize your vesting period, cliff, and start date to fit your needs.
creating, sending, and tracking Simple Agreements for Future Equity (SAFEs) from your Dashboard
